text_en: Jinshi Data, October 3 — Driven by increased foreign investment and growth in factory output, Vietnam's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter, bringing the country closer to the government's full-year double-digit growth target. Data released by Vietnam's National Statistics Office on Saturday showed that the economy grew 9.95% year-on-year in the third quarter, the fastest pace since the third quarter of 2022, higher than the median estimate of 8.65% and above the revised 8.81% in the second quarter. As one of Asia's best-performing economies, Vietnam's government set an economic growth target of at least 10% this year, hoping to upgrade its industrial chain and join the ranks of high-income countries by 2045. The latest data indicate that Vietnam's economy is moving toward this goal, and large-scale infrastructure investment is also achieving the expected results. Trade performance was especially strong.
